reuse.why: Uses the existing recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and the shared applyWeekendRule that getUpcomingDates and getNextDate already use, plus the months day helpers.

duplication.why: The RSchedule setup and try/captureBreadcrumb wrapper repeat getUpcomingDates, but the weekend rule itself is not reimplemented.

placement.why: The handler lives beside schedule/get-upcoming-dates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered the same way.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear loop with a named, commented padding constant; the expansion skeleton shared with getUpcomingDates is not factored out.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Weekend handling goes through the shared applyWeekendRule.

disguised_duplication.where: The RSchedule/try/captureBreadcrumb skeleton in getDatesInRange visibly mirrors getUpcomingDates; it is ordinary boilerplate, not a disguised copy of a rule.
